plans ranked by expected diversity gain with the real 256-row / 117-expert corpus as the worked example

The real corpus has no capability_domain labels. validate() reports that axis as ABSENT rather than filling it in.

rank.rank_rule: Expected diversity gain, not size. The real 256-row corpus spanning 117 experts taught the screen enough to fail the family. A 4096-row recapture of the same window would teach less. New surfaces (router, routed-output, terminal-logit) outrank more hidden rows; a disjoint hidden window outranks a redundant recapture, which is refused rather than ranked.

worked_example_real_corpus.lesson: 256 rows spanning 117 experts and 256 distinct ordered top-k sets were enough for the screen to fail the family. Row count is the least interesting axis.
